faq.q: Should I shut off utilities as soon as I sign sale papers?
faq.a: Confirm the agreement, remaining property access, funding and possession arrangements first. A signing appointment alone is not a service-handoff plan. Coordinate dates with the closing team, buyer and actual providers.

faq.q: Does changing a billing address stop electricity service?
faq.a: Do not assume so. Reliant's account guidance distinguishes the mailing address from the service address and says a billing-address change does not change where electricity is supplied. Confirm your own provider's stop or transfer process.

faq.q: Will one utility-transfer request handle water and electricity?
faq.a: Do not assume one request covers different services. Identify who supplies and bills each account, then obtain separate confirmations where required. A Houston mailing address alone does not establish your water provider.

faq.q: Can I request a Cash As-Is review if utilities are already off?
faq.a: Yes. Explain which services are off and any known condition or access issue before a visit. Ask what evaluation is possible; do not energize damaged equipment or promise every system has been tested.
